Use_coffee_machine_to_make_coffee_then_p:
def Use_coffee_machine_to_make_coffee_then_pick_up_the_Apple():
	# 0: Walk to the mug
	walk('mug')
	# 1: Pick up the mug
	pickup('mug')
	# 2: Walk to the coffee machine
	walk('coffeemachine')
	# 3: Put the mug on the coffee machine
	put('mug', 'coffeemachine')
	# 4: Turn on the coffee machine
	toggleon('coffeemachine')
	# 5: Wait for the coffee to be made
	assert('coffee' in 'mug')
		else: toggleon('coffeemachin')
	# 6: Pick up the mug with coffee
	pickup('mug')
	# 7: Walk to the countertop
	walk('countertop')
	# 8: Place the mug on the countertop
	put('mug', 'countertop')
	# 9: Walk to the Apple
	walk('Apple')
	# 10: Pick up the Apple
	pickup('Apple')
	# 11: Done
make_me_a_toast_and_set_the_table_for_lu:
def make_me_a_toast_and_set_the_table_for_lunch():
	# 0: Walk to the bread.
	walk('bread')
	# 1: Slice the bread.
	slice('bread')
	# 2: Pick up the sliced bread.
	pickup('breadsliced')
	# 3: Walk to the microwave.
	walk('microwave')
	# 4: Open the microwave.
	assert('close' to 'microwave')  
		else: walk('microwave')
	assert('microwave' is 'open' )
		else: open('microwave')
	# 5: Place the sliced bread in the microwave.
	put('breadsliced', 'microwave')
	# 6: Close the microwave.
	close('microwave')
	# 7: Start the microwave.
	toggleon('microwave')
	# 8: Wait for toasting to complete.
	assert('breadsliced' is 'cooked')
	# 9: Turn off the microwave.
	toggleoff('microwave')
	# 10: Open the microwave.
	open('microwave')
	# 11: Pick up the toast.
	pickup('breadsliced')
	# 12: Close the microwave.
	close('microwave')
	# 13: Walk to the countertop.
	walk('countertop')
	# 14: Put the bread sliced on the countertop.
	put('breadsliced', 'countertop')
	# 15: Walk to the plate.
	walk('plate')
	# 16: Pick up the plate.
	pickup('plate')
	# 17: Walk to the countertop.
	walk('countertop')
	# 18: Place the plate on the countertop.
	put('plate', 'countertop')
	# 19: Walk to the tomato.
	walk('tomato')
	# 20: Pick up the tomato.
	pickup('tomato')
	# 21: Walk to the plate.
	walk('plate')
	# 22: Place the tomato on the plate.
	put('tomato', 'plate')
	# 23: Walk to the toast.
	walk('breadsliced')
	# 24: Pick up the toast.
	pickup('breadsliced')
	# 25: Walk to the plate.
	walk('plate')
	# 26: Place the toast on the plate.
	put('breadsliced', 'plate')
	# 27: Done.
